title: Supplication of the traveller for the resident
description: A supplication to be said for someone who is staying home when you are traveling.

duas.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
duas.arabic: أَسْتَـوْدِعُكُـمُ اللَّهَ الَّـذي لا تَضـيعُ وَدائِعُـه
duas.reference: Ahmad 2/403, Ibn Majah 2/943. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/133.

occasion: When bidding farewell to someone who is staying home
benefits: Seeking Allah's protection and care for those left behind during travel
